findings.message: The default root calculation still assumes the script lives in the repository's top-level scripts directory. After this move, direct execution without AO_REPO_ROOT resolves REPO_ROOT to packages/cli/src/assets (or dist/assets), so update commands use nonexistent package paths. ao-doctor.sh retains the same assumption and reports false installation failures. Update both fallbacks for the relocated layout, or retain working wrappers at the original paths.
